meta.title: Sardes AI — AI stock & crypto chart analysis
meta.description: Snap a photo of any trading chart and get an AI-powered analysis: score, risks, news and a clear buying strategy in seconds. Free on iOS and Android.

hero.eyebrow: AI chart analysis for stocks & crypto
hero.sub: Point your camera at any trading chart. Sardes AI reads it, pulls live prices, news and analyst views, and turns it into a clear plan in seconds.

ticker.label: Stocks, crypto and BIST — all in a single scan

steps.title: From screenshot to strategy in three taps

items.title: Snap
items.body: Photograph any chart — TradingView, your broker app, a monitor. A screenshot works too.

items.title: Analyze
items.body: Sardes AI reads the chart, then checks live prices, fundamentals, technicals, news and sentiment.

items.title: Act
items.body: Get entry, stop loss, take profit and risk/reward — matched to your investing style.

features.title: Everything behind one number
features.sub: Not just a signal. A full, readable breakdown you can actually reason about.

match.title: Fits your preferences?
match.label: Moderately compatible
match.body: Matched against your risk tolerance and investment goals.

risks.title: Risks & key insights
risks.risk: High P/E suggests potential overvaluation if growth falters.
risks.insight: Analyst upgrades signal positive market sentiment.

news.title: Market news
news.item: Stock eyes a retest of highs amid analyst upgrades

trust.title: Built to inform, not to hype
trust.body: Sardes AI provides AI-generated analysis for educational and informational purposes only. It is not financial advice and past performance does not guarantee future results. Screens show example data. Always do your own research before investing.
points: No account needed to try it

qr.title: On desktop? Scan with your phone
qr.body: Point your camera at the code — we'll open the right store for your device.

final.title: Your next trade deserves a second opinion.
final.sub: Download Sardes AI and scan your first chart in under a minute.
